decision: Restore the product qualification foundation from Project ECHO commit f316d565 and adapt it to the standalone repository's canonical core/adapters boundary, root shrinkwrap, runtime schemas, and current CLI contract.
implemented_capabilities: versioned qualification matrix and report schema with machine, reviewer, and founder authority separation
Git-object build-once artifact with source SHA, dependency lock, package inventory, and SHA-256 binding
standalone product import fence and hermetic qualification suite
hashed offline support bundle, exact-cache install, target evidence aggregation, and terminal red/green gate
DEV-only GitHub qualification workflow that uploads evidence without granting release authority
architectural_invariants: the immutable extraction provenance baseline remains unchanged
qualification tools use only paths and dependencies present in echo-brain
the root npm-shrinkwrap.json is the sole checked-in dependency authority
the product artifact contains both canonical meeting-context and runtime-config schemas
CI can emit only an incomplete DEV draft; human-authority cells cannot be passed by CI
a red or missing mandatory matrix cell blocks the terminal gate
